title: Prerequisites
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:16 AM
determine the collection agency to which the receivables are to be submitted for items released both manually and automatically.

As a result of the release, the released items receive the submission status 01 (Receivable Released for Submission). The

document receives the collection item number OO1.

Prerequisites

You have authorization to submit receivables to collection agencies (authorization object F_KKINK).

Activities

1. For the system to determine the collection agency automatically, specify the collection agencies you work with in

Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable under |sBusiness Transactions » Submit to Collection Agency
Define Collection Agencies “J, or on the SAP Easy Access screen, choose |}Settings » Current Settings } Define

Collection Agencies

. Program an installation-specific function module and enter it for event 5060 in the Customizing for Contract Accounts

Receivable and Payable under |}#Program Enhancements » Define Customer-Specific Function Modules %. (See the
documentation for function module FKK_SAMPLE_5060.)

At event 5060, you can determine the collection agency, for example, using the following criteria:
o Total amount of the receivables of a business partner to be released
o Business partner type (private/business customer)
o Business partner address (postal code)

In event 5060, you can also implement the determination of collection agencies from external systems and define the order
in which receivables are to be submitted to the collection agencies that you work with.

. If, in your organization, you release receivables to different collection agencies based on specific rules, you can define these

derivation rules in Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable under |*Business Transactions » Submit to
Collection Agency » Define Derivation Rules for Collection Agencies Responsible

The derivation rules defined in Customizing are evaluated by the derivation tool. The derivation tool is always called in
function module FKK_COLL_AG SAMPLE 5060, if items are released for collection individually or in a mass release. The
derivation tool determines the responsible collection agency in one or more derivation steps from a number of source fields
of the extendable structure FKKCOLLAG. The number of derivation steps corresponds to the number of derivation rules
that you define in Customizing.

. In event 5059, which is processed when you release receivables, you can exclude items from being released. To do this,

define exclusion criteria in an installation-specific function module and enter this module for event 5059 in Customizing for
Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable under |Program Enhancements » Define Customer-Specific Function
Modules 33. (See the documentation for sample function module FKK_SAMPLE_ 5059.)

Manual Release

Use

Releasing individual uncollectible receivables for collection and resetting the release
